data.title: 山田杏奈 · 拍摄休息室大号卫衣的大长腿瘫坐·「拍摄好累哦……市川，给我吃一口软糖嘛」
data.description: 摄影工作结束，杏奈换上宽松连帽卫衣和牛仔短裤，坐进休息室的皮沙发里。她把扎发的发圈取下放在靠垫旁，黑发散到肩上；看到你拿出软糖，立刻抬起头，从宽袖口里伸出一根手指指向糖袋，疲惫的脸也跟着亮了起来。
data.location: 摄影棚后台休息区皮沙发
data.action: 散发坐在摄影休息室沙发上，抬头望向软糖袋，伸手指示自己也想尝一颗。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
data.mood: 大型犬撒娇、惊人大长腿
data.promptProse: The sight of a gummy-candy packet brings Anna Yamada out of her post-shoot tiredness on the dressing-room sofa. Wearing a loose charcoal hoodie and denim shorts, she points toward the packet with a fingertip emerging from the cuff. Her long black hair is down, and the removed hair tie rests beside a cushion. Warm mirror bulbs illuminate her hopeful brown eyes, the sofa arm and a neatly packed clothing case nearby.
